children: TerraVolt entered into two options with Wickel Land Company to purchase approximately 1,077 acres in Cassia County, Idaho, at $30,000 per acre. One option covers approximately 903.3 acres payable in cash, while the other covers approximately 174.1 acres payable at closing through a convertible secured promissory note. The company plans to develop the site as a digital infrastructure campus designed to support 240 megawatts of on-site power, and must exercise both options together.
